create_RearrangeGraspManager: create a RearrangeGraspManager instance to manage robot agent grasping onto rigid and articulated objects in the simulator
snap_to_obj: snap a rigid object to the robot end effector by creating fixed constraints and updating collision groups
snap_to_marker: snap the robot end effector to a named marker on an articulated object using point-to-point constraints
desnap: remove all active hold constraints and release the currently grasped object or marker from the robot gripper
is_violating_hold_constraint: check if the grasped object has drifted too far from the end effector beyond the hold threshold
